note: Canonical asset registry for Canton Payment Streams (V2-only per STR-79). Per-asset routing (admin party, Scan endpoint URL, wallet-gateway URL, V2 capability flags) used by the SDK and adoption-metrics tooling. Generated by scripts/build-asset-registry.mjs; committed manually after review. CC and USDCx are NOT in the registry yet because they have not published Token Standard V2 interfaces. Per CIP-0112 §5, assets are expected to publish V2 alongside V1; once CC or USDCx advertise V2 in supportedApis, add them here with allocationsV2 = true.
